systems.system: Numérisation du dossier des patients (Visa Médical)
systems.country_label: Renforcement des capacités et numérisation du dossier des patients – Armée du Salut/RD Congo
systems.owner: Armée du Salut (implementer), SANRU Asbl (principal recipient), funded by SANOFI, technical support from Visa Médical
systems.tiers: Salvation Army health facilities (formations sanitaires); number not stated

note: Launched 10 March 2026. The document describes the digitised patient record as serving the follow-up of diabetic and hypertensive patients only, so it is classed as a one-programme tracker and gives no emr fact; the parent should weigh this against document 2, which describes the same product (Visa Medical) as a general patient record in Guinea. Funding is SANOFI; the Ministry of Public Health attended and the Provincial Health Division proclaimed the launch.
